metadata.expected_retained_cache_bytes: At most 500 record references (~4000 bytes on x64) plus fixed gate/array overhead per live immutable generation; no global cache.
metadata.publication_fixture: Candidate/current use the existing production CopyRecords against the same frozen ConcurrentDictionary, then the actual PublishedSnapshot constructor. No filesystem changes or watchers during timed benchmark. Develop dictionary is unchanged and has no publication step.
metadata.cold_first_generation: Republish, force GC outside timing, then measure first full-size empty query; no full-size warmup. Gen-specific lazy sort cost is included.
metadata.warm_repeated: One first query per engine is separately recorded as warm_seed, then 30 alternating repeated queries without publication or forced GC.
metadata.after_publication: Publish a fresh immutable snapshot outside query timing, then immediately measure its first query, without forced GC. Publication metrics recorded separately.
metadata.limits: Portable Linux synthetic search core only, not Windows or UI. Per-sample GC counts establish coincidence, not proof of causation. CPU is process-wide/coarse. Previous adverse raw benchmark is retained unchanged.
